locales.error-language-active: Deactivate the language before deleting it — this removes every string translated into it.
locales.error-key-exists: The key {{key}} is already translated in this language.
locales.error-key-collision: The key {{key}} cannot be used alongside {{existing}}: one of them would have to be both a text and a group of texts.
locales.error-key-invalid: The key {{key}} is not a usable translation key.
locales.error-tenant-unknown: The tenant {{tenant}} is not one this deployment serves — see GET /locales/tenants.
locales.error-language-is-fallback: The fallback locale {{tag}} cannot be deactivated or deleted — every translatable entity's source row lives there.
locales.error-entity-type-unknown: {{entityType}} is not a registered translatable entity type.
locales.error-translation-field-unknown: {{field}} is not a translatable field of {{entityType}}.
locales.error-translation-fields-empty: A translation's fields cannot be empty — omit the locale to leave it alone, or send null to delete it.
locales.error-translation-fallback-required: The fallback locale {{locale}} cannot be deleted — it is what every other language falls back to.
